# Copilot Instructions — Task Tracker Frontend

This repo is used for Module 3 of an AI-Augmented Software Development course.

- Start broad only for product-intent exploration; narrow before editing.
- Do not add build tooling or runtime dependencies.
- Preserve the existing file structure unless explicitly asked.
- Use safe DOM node creation for user-provided task text.
- Keep localStorage as fallback even after API integration.
- Use tests for pure logic and API client behavior.
- Use manual browser checks for DOM behavior.
- After changes, summarize diff, verification commands, and remaining risks.
